policy: Prospect-only competitive point estimates withheld until debut and regular-role timing are separately calibrated. Missing fit is not zero value. Published ETAs are evidence, not regular-role dates. Conditional scenarios do not enter trade totals.
scenario_definition: Frozen annual development utility shifted to a published ETA anchor plus an illustrative 0/1/2-year delay to regular playing time. Delays have no assigned probabilities; scenarios are not forecasts or confidence bounds. Non-arrival is not newly estimated. Finite 2027–2034 horizon retained.

additional_evidence.meaning: Published arrival estimate; not guaranteed regular MLB playing time
